source.notes: ICSE Class IX school annual examination paper (school not named). Header prints 'Annual Examination (2023-24)', 'Class-IX', 'Mathematics', 'Time: 2½ hrs.', 'Total Marks: 80'; examYear 2024 is the later year of the printed session (also the year in the file name). Section A (40 marks): attempt all of Q1-Q3; Section B (40 marks): answer any four of Q4-Q10 (10 marks each), so the pack's marks total (110) exceeds the 80 maximum. Q1 prints only a group total [15] for its fifteen MCQs, so it is kept as one entry. The mathematics paper is pages 1-4 of the PDF; pages 5-7 carry a separate Class IX Chemistry paper (Annual Examination (2023-24)) that is not part of this pack. The scan shows some handwritten corrections (notably Q8(c), whose printed text is struck through); handwriting was ignored and the printed text kept. The PDF has no text layer (watermark only); text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against the page images; fractions, powers and roots were rebuilt inline from the page images. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
